aggregation_and_uncertainty.OD600: Author OD600 summary means pool the recorded steady-state OD measurements, retaining 15/18, 12/18, 15/21, 15/15, 19/21 and 18/18. Stored author outlier flags were read from BiomassMeasurementsOutliers.xlsx; all source OD values match BiomassMeasurements.xlsx. Means and sample SDs from retained values reproduce the author summary. These counts are not asserted to be independent chemostat biological replicates.
aggregation_and_uncertainty.author_preprocessing_only: No new outlier rule or alternative estimator was chosen from label magnitudes. The existing author processData.m uses MATLAB isoutlier(...,'median'), replaces flagged values with NaN, and computes means/SD/SE on retained measurements. Supplement S4 lines 57-62 independently describes that filtering.
aggregation_and_uncertainty.author_rate_statistic_qualification: FluxesBiomassStatistics.xlsx is an experimentally derived Monte Carlo uncertainty-propagation summary, not an independent flux assay or a kinetic-model prediction. processData.m line 364 calculates its column labelled SE using std(metaboliteFluxDistribution,1), not SE across independent cultures. The sampled t distributions include low degrees of freedom (including df=1); these simulated summary statistics and their marginal bounds are not promoted to label confidence intervals.
aggregation_and_uncertainty.biomass_factor: Author processData.m lines 60-84 first averages three technical measurements within each of four biological replicate IDs, then applies the median outlier rule to the biological-replicate means. Retained biological replicate IDs are [1,2,3,4] for Bcar2, [2,3,4] for Bcar3, and [1,2,3,4] for Bcar4. Published factor means and SDs were independently reproduced by arithmetic; one factor is shared across the two dilution settings of a strain.
aggregation_and_uncertainty.hplc: Three technical measurements are released per fixed condition. The author's retained counts are 2, 3, 2, 2, 3, 3. Source-excluded HPLC cells are Lycopene!B3, D4, and E4. These are replicate exclusions made by the author, NOT exclusions of conditions by this curation. All 18 original concentration values are preserved below.
aggregation_and_uncertainty.hplc_filter_verification: The documented default median criterion was checked as abs(value-median) > 3*MAD/Phi_inverse(0.75); retained means, sample SDs and counts match the existing author output. This was arithmetic verification, not execution of author MATLAB code or a new data-cleaning pass.
aggregation_and_uncertainty.no_pseudoreplication: Only six condition-level labels are created; technical HPLC/OD measurements or shared calibration replicates are not expanded into independent test cases.
remaining_limitations: Intracellular content is reconstructed from condition-level mass and biomass means, rather than directly released as mg/gDW with matched replicate-level denominators.
The author released already converted broth carotenoid concentrations; raw chromatograms, extraction recoveries, and the preceding peak-area calibration were not independently reconstructed.
The reported steady-state protocol is accepted with the four-versus-five-residence-time distinction preserved; no unseen time course was used to certify stabilization.

The strict chemistry lane remains blocked and the three redox alternatives remain unverified hypotheses. These measurements cannot repair missing downstream/enzyme constraints or validate a hypothesis mechanism.
Primary-article XML, NIST HTML, and ChEBI JSON are live representations rather than immutable archives; hashes below identify retrieved bytes. Pinned author GitHub files are commit-addressed.
aggregation_and_uncertainty.supplement_code_difference: Supplement S4 reports one million Monte Carlo particles; the pinned processData.m line 54 sets simulationN=1e7. Neither simulation was executed here, and neither supplies the final labels. This documentary discrepancy does not affect the deterministic measured-mass normalization.
aggregation_and_uncertainty.uncertainty_policy: Original author SDs, SEs, counts, degrees of freedom and rate intervals are retained as provenance, not as newly estimated label uncertainty. No confidence interval is fabricated for C/(OD*F); pairing/covariance between measurements is unavailable and shared calibrations create dependence. Extraction recovery and HPLC calibration uncertainty are not independently quantified in the released concentration table.

normalization.numeric_representation: Workbook numeric XML strings are preserved below. Labels are the deterministic Python binary64 result of C/(OD*F), with no additional rounding. Extra digits preserve reproducibility, not experimental precision.
normalization.point_estimator: Ratio of the three author measurement-summary means; not a ratio of Monte Carlo means and not an average of paired single-cell or biological-replicate contents.

rate_derivation_verified_before_any_poss.author_code_units: Lycopene concentration is mg/L; MolWeights.xlsx Data!B6:C6 is 536872.6 mg/mol. Thus concentration*1000/MW_mg_per_mol gives mmol/L. The source does not use 536872.6 g/mol.
rate_derivation_verified_before_any_poss.correct_rate_inversion_if_used: content_mg_per_gDW = q_mmol_per_gDW_per_h * 536.8726_g_per_mol / mu_per_h. Since g/mol equals mg/mmol numerically, there is NO additional factor of 1000. Article nmol/gDCW/h rates would first be multiplied by 1e-6 to obtain mmol/gDCW/h.
rate_derivation_verified_before_any_poss.equation: For lycopene absent from the feed, q_mmol_per_gDW_per_h = mu_per_h * content_mg_per_gDW / MW_mg_per_mmol.
rate_derivation_verified_before_any_poss.reason: Original measured mass concentrations and measured biomass-normalization summaries are available for all six. The author rate summary uses Monte Carlo propagation of those measurements. Its mean need not equal the formula evaluated at the input means; it is not silently treated as a direct mass-content measurement.
rate_derivation_verified_before_any_poss.source: Supporting Information S4, pages S37-S38, lines 54-85, Eq. S1; author data_pre-processing/fluxes/processData.m lines 231-318, 325-327, 353-365 and 391-393.

normalization.unit_derivation: (mg/L) / (OD600 * ((gDCW/L)/OD600)) = mg/gDCW = mg/gDW. No factor of 1000 is present in this mass-normalization formula.

primary_experimental_evidence.article_coordinate: Methods 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.1.4; JATS sec2.1.1, sec2.1.2, sec2.1.4; experimental Table 2/tbl2; Data Availability Statement/_adda93_.
primary_experimental_evidence.assay: Cell pellets from 15 mL broth were extracted with hexane and bead disruption, extracts evaporated and resuspended in acetone, and lycopene separated/measured by HPLC. This is an extracted intracellular pool, not extracellular secretion or a modeled pathway-flux observation.
primary_experimental_evidence.author_repository_attribution: The primary article Data Availability Statement explicitly links https://github.com/SysBioengLab/BcarGRASP.
primary_experimental_evidence.balanced_growth_qualification: The reported chemostat steady state supports the balanced-growth pool interpretation. Raw BiomassMeasurements.xlsx Commentary!A2 says biomass measurements were taken after four residence times at steady state, whereas article carotenoid sampling is after five. This distinction is retained; time-alignment and independent stabilization cannot be established from these summaries alone.
primary_experimental_evidence.broth_concentration_unit_evidence: MetabolitesMeasurements.xlsx Commentary!A2 explicitly says lycopene and beta-carotene were extracted, concentrations in fermentation broth previously calculated, units mg/L. Commentary!A3 identifies rows as technical replicates and columns as conditions. No extra extraction-volume or broth-dilution factor is invented.
primary_experimental_evidence.citation: Elizondo BR and Saa PA (2025), Complex Kinetic Models Predict beta-Carotene Production and Reveal Flux Limitations in Recombinant Saccharomyces cerevisiae Strains, ACS Synthetic Biology 14(9), DOI 10.1021/acssynbio.5c00256, PMID 40891387, PMCID PMC12455641.
primary_experimental_evidence.cultivation: Glucose-limited aerobic continuous cultures of the three recombinant strains at nominal dilution rates 0.1 and 0.25 per hour. Methods 2.1.2 reports sampling after five residence times in technical triplicates.
primary_experimental_evidence.dry_weight_basis: Methods 2.1.2 estimates dry-cell weight from OD600 using strain-specific measured conversion factors, rounded in the article to 0.53, 0.54, and 0.50 (gDCW/L)/OD600. Labels use the unrounded author-workbook means, not those rounded display values.
primary_experimental_evidence.net_versus_gross_decision: Methods 2.1.4 identifies SK_lyc and SK_b_car as separate intracellular membrane-accumulation drains estimated from measured carotenoid content and biomass. Lycopene is an intermediate in the expressed Phaffia CrtE/CrtYB/CrtI beta-carotene pathway. Labels normalize the measured lycopene pool only; no beta-carotene concentration/flux is added or subtracted, and no gross desaturase flux, FVA flux, or kinetic fit is substituted.

selection.estimator_rule: The same ratio of author-reported means is applied to every fixed condition. Existing author replicate filtering is retained without new exclusions. This is a measurement-derived estimate, not a directly published mg/gDW observation or a mean of independently paired replicate ratios.
selection.selection_basis: The previously fixed six-condition packet, not outcome magnitudes or predictions. No alternative dataset, condition subset, or favorable hypothesis was selected.
selection.source_hierarchy_decision: Use original HPLC-derived lycopene concentrations and author measurement-summary means with measured biomass normalization. The source_index.json rate workbook is verified as a measurement-derived dilution drain but is not the numerical label source: its rate means are Monte Carlo uncertainty-propagation statistics. Direct mass normalization avoids representing those simulated summary statistics as directly measured content.
